sage: Slow and steady wins the race.

A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
All things come to those who wait.
The early bird catches the worm.
Nothing is impossible to a willing heart.
You reap what you sow — so sow smiles.
Silence is golden, but a smile is a treasure.
It’s never too late to do the right thing.
Running water never goes stale.
Work banishes the three great evils.
Courage is measured by persistence.
Steady hands keep the ship on course.
A smile is worth a thousand words.
Great things are made of small victories.
Every hour of work is a seed for tomorrow.
Night brings counsel, morning brings action.
The main thing is to keep moving forward.
Little strokes fell great oaks.
Nothing ventured, nothing gained.
Well begun is half done.
Time heals wounds and rewards patience.
You can’t harvest what you never sowed.
Perseverance is the twin sister of success.
After rain comes fair weather.
Haste makes waste.

Seek and you shall find.

The customer’s smile is the best reward.
Gentleness beats force.
Every worker deserves their wage.
Tomorrow is built today.

games_rps_desc: The classic duel against the computer (first to 5).
games_morpion_desc: Line up 3 symbols against the computer.
games_memory_desc: Match the emoji pairs in as few moves as possible.
games_snake_desc: Catch the apples without biting your tail.
games_snake_hint: Press an arrow key to start
games_catch_desc: Catch the letters to spell the word. 5 levels.
games_catch_win: Well done, all words are written!
games_catch_lose: Lost! Play again to beat your record.
games_catch_hint: Move the mouse or finger to catch the cyan letters
games_dactylo_howto_course: Type the displayed word as fast as possible for 60 seconds. A correct word increases the combo multiplier (🔥). A typo resets the combo. Final score depends on word length, combo and speed.
games_dactylo_howto_survie: Type the falling words before they reach the bottom. Each missed word costs a life (❤️). Speed increases at every level — 3 lives, stay focused!
games_dactylo_howto_deft: Type the 10 words as fast as possible. The game measures your speed in words per minute (WPM), your accuracy and total time.
games_anagram_desc: Put the letters in order to find the word.
games_anagram_rules: Rearrange the scrambled letters to find the word (hint on top). Validate with OK or Enter. 3 mistakes max, 30 seconds per word, 3 difficulty levels.
games_catch_rules: Catch the glowing letter to write the word: expected letters are cyan, others are traps. A wrong caught letter costs a life (❤️). Write all the words to win — 5 levels.
